root_cause: Powerhouse could optimize and report intermediate acquisition outputs without a system-wide invariant that makes paid orders and realized revenue the commercial terminal objective.
SEO, content, social, leads and pipeline could be treated as successful outputs even while no paid order had been evidenced.

evidence.operator_state: Operator reported on 2026-09-28 that no order has been received.

prevention: While no paid order is evidenced, FIRST_PAID_ORDER is the primary commercial objective.
REALIZED_PAID_REVENUE_EUR is the terminal commercial success metric.
Impressions, rankings, traffic, publishing volume, leads and pipeline are diagnostic/intermediate metrics only.
Every acquisition action maps to market problem -> qualified prospect/visit -> CTA/contact -> lead -> meeting -> proposal -> paid order -> realized revenue -> learning.
Chats, agents, skills, workflows, schedulers, portal, cockpits and future capabilities inherit the invariant from One Brain.
Safe executable commercial actions are executed rather than returned as advice; unsolicited outbound communication remains human-authorized.
